company.name: QuantumScape
company.shortDescription: QuantumScape develops solid-state lithium-metal batteries for electric vehicles and other energy storage applications.
company.description:
QuantumScape develops solid-state lithium-metal batteries for electric vehicles and other energy storage applications.

The company works to revolutionize the battery industry by producing a solid-state battery that will provide a substantially higher level of battery storage than other batteries currently on the market. It manufactures lithium batteries aimed to accelerate the commercialization of solid-state batteries. The company's innovative approach could significantly impact the future of electric transportation and renewable energy integration.

Jagdeep Singh founded the company in San Jose, California in 2010.

productsAndServices.description: An anode-free battery architecture using a proprietary ceramic solid-state separator and lithium-metal anode to support higher energy density, faster charging, longer life, and improved thermal safety than conventional lithium-ion cells.

aiResearchSummary.text: QuantumScape is focused on developing solid-state lithium-metal batteries, as evidenced by their research into battery stacks and packs that manage volumetric expansion. This is crucial for batteries with lithium metal negative electrodes, enhancing their application in electric vehicles and energy storage. Their work aims to improve battery control systems, ensuring efficient and reliable performance. These efforts highlight QuantumScape's commitment to advancing battery technology for sustainable energy solutions.
